cases.name: the UI sorts its tabs instead of following the catalog
caught_by: the UI's tabs are in the catalog's order, not some order of their own

cases.name: a table's columns are reordered
cases.old: export const TABLES: Record<string, string[]> = shown(CATALOG_TABLES);
cases.new: export const TABLES: Record<string, string[]> = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(shown(CATALOG_TABLES)).map(([n, c]) => [n, [...c].reverse()]));
caught_by: the UI shows every table the catalog has, minus the ones it names
